issue.title: load_minigraph consistently fails on S6100 T0 and T1 testbeds.

failure.body:
**Description**

`load_minigraph` fails with errors seen in starting the Telemetry service.
The telemetry service throws an error as it depends on `/var/platform` dir's presence.

In turn  `/var/platform` dir is not created because of an error seen in `<HOSTNAME>` file and the `mkdir` step is never executed:
https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/blob/master/files/image_config/platform/<HOSTNAME>#L361

`<HOSTNAME>` is wrongly entering NOS to SONiC migration section of code, when this is merely SONiC to SONiC upgrade. I believe that this is a regression caused by https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/pull/5234

Errors seen in `<HOSTNAME>`:
```
Oct  1 <IPV6> sonic <HOSTNAME>[447]: + log_migration ERROR: /mnt/nos_migration/mgmt_interface.cfg not found!
Oct  1 <IPV6> sonic <HOSTNAME>[447]: + log_migration ERROR: /mnt/nos_migration/mgmt_interface.cfg not found!
Oct  1 <IPV6> sonic <HOSTNAME>[447]: + echo ERROR: /mnt/nos_migration/mgmt_interface.cfg not found!
Oct  1 <IPV6> sonic <HOSTNAME>[447]: + echo ERROR: /mnt/nos_migration/mgmt_interface.cfg not found!

Oct  1 <IPV6> sonic <HOSTNAME>[447]: + mount /mnt/onie-boot
Oct  1 <IPV6> sonic <HOSTNAME>[447]: + mount /mnt/onie-boot
Oct  1 <IPV6> sonic <HOSTNAME>[447]: mount: can't find /mnt/onie-boot in /etc/fstab
Oct  1 <IPV6> sonic <HOSTNAME>[447]: mount: can't find /mnt/onie-boot in /etc/fstab
Oct  1 <IPV6> sonic <HOSTNAME>[447]: + . /mnt/onie-boot/onie/grub.d/50_onie_grub
Oct  1 <IPV6> sonic <HOSTNAME>[447]: + . /mnt/onie-boot/onie/grub.d/50_onie_grub
Oct  1 <IPV6> sonic <HOSTNAME>[447]: /etc/<HOSTNAME>: 346: .: Can't open /mnt/onie-boot/onie/grub.d/50_onie_grub
Oct  1 <IPV6> sonic <HOSTNAME>[447]: /etc/<HOSTNAME>: 346: .: Can't open /mnt/onie-boot/onie/grub.d/50_onie_grub
```

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. Install a new latest image
2. Execute command `sudo config load_minigraph -y`
3. The last step would fail as:
`Executing restart of service telemetry... Job for telemetry.service failed because the control process exited with error code.`

**Describe the results you received:**
```
Oct  1 <IPV6>.666479 str-s6100-acs-5 INFO telemetry.sh[19002]: Creating new telemetry container with HWSKU Force10-S6100
Oct  1 <IPV6>.807194 str-s6100-acs-5 INFO dhcp_relay.sh[18936]: dhcp_relay
Oct  1 <IPV6>.825976 str-s6100-acs-5 INFO systemd[1]: Started DHCP relay container.
Oct  1 <IPV6>.833017 str-s6100-acs-5 INFO hostcfgd: Running cmd: 'sudo systemctl enable pmon.service'
Oct  1 <IPV6>.897429 str-s6100-acs-5 INFO telemetry.sh[19002]: Error response from daemon: invalid mount config for type "bind": bind source path does not exist: /var/platform/
Oct  1 <IPV6>.902717 str-s6100-acs-5 INFO telemetry.sh[19002]: Failed to docker run
Oct  1 <IPV6>.907558 str-s6100-acs-5 ERR systemd[1]: Failed to start Telemetry container.
Oct  1 <IPV6>.936166 str-s6100-acs-5 ERR config[15832]: Failed to execute restart of service telemetry with error 1
```

**Describe the results you expected:**
`config load_minigraph` should pass.

resolution.title: [rc.local] separate configuration migration and grub installation logic
resolution.description:
**- Why I did it**
To address issue #5525

**- How I did it**
Explicitly control the grub installation requirement when it is needed. We have scenario where configuration migration happened but grub installation is not required.

Signed-off-by: Ying Xie <<EMAIL>>

**- How to verify it**
Build image and test on S6100.

**- Which release branch to backport (provide reason below if selected)**

- [x] 201811
- [x] 201911
- [ ] 202006
